   source that also holds a MOB finding raised a MOB cell's marker. It now takes the cell's lens and uses
   `_lens_clause` (one helper). Every other query of source_value_extractions / extraction_relations in
   assess_cell.py was checked: _gather (gather_sources, gather_findings, gather_confirmers: clause on the
   gathered row; the confirmed row t reaches the cell through gather_sources), count_extractions,
   gather_extraction_links (in_lens), conditioned_governing (intersected with the in-lens governing ids),
   compose_value (ids of governing links), _confirmed_bands (fixed). Case T019-20; red on the unchanged query.
F2 fixed: link_payload hashes each figure's in-lens state (`<role>:<id>:out`), read from v_live_lens_links; K01
   re-derives it from the same view and also fails a stored lens reason that disagrees with it. A lens link
   added to, or retired from, a figure that stays `excluded` now makes stale_determinations, K01 and the
   handshake audit red. Reproduced on scratch copies holding an engine-written 3xMOB cell (extraction 164
   add-lens-link MOB; link 23 of extraction 33 retired): stale_determinations was [] on 95b730b and is
   [(9, ['derivation_sha'])] now, for both. RULE_VERSION stays pilot-6 (the file's derivation command
   was re-run; unmerged). Docstrings and the audit's failure text name lens links.
F3 documented, design left open: the `excluded` out-of-lens link rows (task item 3, for K02) are a second home of
   what v_live_lens_links says, and they couple every cell to every figure of its parameter. Two
   consequences observed: a new figure of the parameter tagged for another group makes K02 red and every live
   cell of the parameter stale; amend-extraction of an out-of-lens figure is refused naming the cells that
   link it. dbcore.live_determinations_linked said "linked means read for this answer"; it now says "an
   extraction of this parameter". The linking is not removed.
F4 fixed: the pending-cell gap text names the lens as the scope of its count and says how many of the
   parameter's figures lie outside it, both derived by query. The report key `n_extractions` is replaced by
   `n_extractions_in_lens` and `n_extractions_outside_lens`, and the summary line prints
   `extractions_in_lens=` and `outside_lens=`. Readers of the old key and of the old summary text:
   git grep -n -e n_extractions -e 'extractions=' -- scripts skills .claude governance (only assess_cell.py
   and test_assess_cell_pilot.py read them; both repaired). Case T019-23.
F5 fixed: derivation_handshake_integrity exempts a pending row from the missing-path note only when it is
   engine-written (rule_version set) and a live-linked figure of its parameter is stated in its lens (the
   engine's own count_extractions); a hand pending row, one in a lens no figure carries, and a hand
   `provisional` row with no paths are noted. Cases F5-a..d (test_run_pipeline_refusals, on a scratch copy).
F6 fixed: cases T019-24 (needs and medical cells; icf), T019-25 (LIKE wildcards), T019-26 (code splits),
   T019-27 (unkeyed_models: governing figures only, live links only) kill the five surviving mutants; each
   mutant was re-run with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
F7 fixed: T019-14 has a fixture case where a figure carrying the cell's code is governing and non-excluded,
   and the live case now loops over every ALL cell, reports how many hold a non-excluded row and prints
   SKIPPED-NO-FIXTURE when none does. AT-51 is met on the fixture, and live for the ALL cells that have a
   non-excluded row (the case derives them by query).
F8 recorded below.
F9 fixed: the sha() docstring no longer says the extraction count is in the payload; stale_determinations'
   docstring and the audit's failure text name lens links.
F10 fixed: validate_lens refuses a code whose registry row is not `active` in each lens registry that carries
   a status column (identity: deprecated; medical: deprecated, superseded), as add-lens-link refuses a
   deprecated identity. Case T019-28.

What changes on live data (F8). The comparison regenerates with
  D=<scratch dir>; mkdir -p "$D/base" && git archive origin/task/t-018-link-table scripts/assess scripts/dbcore.py schemas | tar -x -C "$D/base"
  python3 -I scratchpad/session_2026-11-13-t019-lens-gather/compare_live.py "$D/base" . "$D"
(compare_live_result.txt in that folder is its output at this commit). It runs the base engine and this one, each on
its own scratch copy, for every active parameter and the identity lenses ALL, BLIND, MOB, MS, SCI and DEAF, and diffs
the --report-json of each cell as well as the summary line. Read from that output:
- Refused, where the base wrote a row: every cell (parameter, identity) no figure of the parameter is stated in,
  e.g. 3xALL, 3xBLIND, 3xDEAF, and every cell of the parameters that have figures for no identity.
- 3xMS and 3xSCI: the base wrote `provisional`, marker weak, value_max 5.0, from the MOB figures; here both are
  `pending`, no marker, no value, no tier basis, no proxy inference, design_scale population.
- 4x, 5x, 6x, 9x, 11x ALL: design_scale universal -> population, and regulatory_stratum_only and code_floor_only
  drop to 0 (the T6 codes, tagged MOB, no longer reach the ALL cell; n_sources falls to 0).
- skimmed_findings, excluded_not_publishable and n_findings_left_out are now over the figures in the cell's lens.
- The cells of MOB keep their state; 3xMOB keeps its value and marker.

Verified in this pass (commands): python3 scripts/tests/test_assess_cell_pilot.py; python3
scripts/tests/test_run_pipeline_refusals.py; the registered checks before and after (failing lines identical);
python3 scripts/run_checks.py --selftest; python3 scripts/audit/research_tooling_separation.py --base
origin/task/t-018-link-table; K01 and K02 on a scratch copy holding an engine-written cell (each examines the
live determination; K01 red under the A1 and A2 reproductions).
EOF
echo ok
